astra-smash-karts: 3D car battle arena: bots, 11 weapon types, map selection. Standalone build (no server, single-player with bots).
business-tycoon: Build a company from $10k to $1M: offices, hiring agents, campaigns, strategy. B/H keys + mouse.
claude-of-duty: Browser COD-style shooter, a reconstruction. Tap/click to load. Procedural graphics.
claude-of-legends: Browser 5v5 MOBA: 3 lanes, 10 champions, jungle, fog of war. Landing page deployed; full game requires a server backend.
fishing-game: Fishing in the dark depths: cast your line, catch whatever bites, collect 22 species. Tap/drag.
gpt6-city-crisis: City crisis management on Three.js. Built from source (Vite).
little-flock: Cozy farm: raise sheep and develop your island. Built from source. ⚠ UI in Chinese.
michi-neko: 3D game about a philosopher cat (Three.js, modules from CDN).
mykonos-island-voxels: Isometric voxel city builder: build a Mediterranean island. Canvas 2D, touch-friendly.
operation-ironhold: Browser FPS built on Three.js: clear 10 targets in a warehouse within 3 minutes. Ported, mobile controls added.
pegsort: 3D puzzle: sort colored rings onto pegs. Language-independent, touch.
runecraft-playable: Playable ad for RuneCraft Survivor: a roguelite-survivor with spell crafting from runes. Pure JavaScript + Canvas, a single 1.6 MB HTML, sprites from the game's 3D models, MRAID / DAPI / Google / Meta.
sallu-theft-auto: GTA-style open world: neon city, cars, chases. WASD + mouse. Three.js. All textures/models AI-generated.
skyhook: Grapple with a cable, swing and climb upward; gold pushes the chasm back. Tap/Space.
soccer-game: Arcade soccer: pick teams, difficulty, half length. Canvas 2D, pointer controls (touch works out of the box).
sonar-maze: You're blind in a maze — each sonar pulse briefly reveals walls, batteries and hunters. 5 levels. Built-in mobile joystick + tap.
uar-tower-defence: Sky Shield — browser tower defense about Ukraine's air defense.
